independence: each question is re-checked on its own: the prompt holds only that question, its options and its own stage-1 answer; routing uses only that question's own stage-1 and image-only answers; a re-check changes only that question's answer; every call is a fresh single-turn chat
decision: routed question with a valid re-check answer -> that answer; otherwise the stage-1 answer
contradiction_policy: computed after all final answers are stored; never used for routing or editing
recheck_sharing: a re-check is computed once per question and tool (greedy decoding, same prompt and images) and shared by the routes; a route's cost counts only the questions it re-checks
cost: rechecks = re-check calls counted for the variant; avg_lvlm_calls_per_q = 1 + rechecks / questions (stage 1 is one call per question); recheck_latency_s / stage1_latency_s = model-call seconds
